description: A synthetic learner for GATE-a11y and the Playwright screenshots (DESIGN.md section 12, one fixture). It is test data, not learner data and not a run. events are event@1 records; mirror holds the lab repo files that the read-only mirror shows. See scripts/spikes/W1-T41/README.md.

resp.text: Re-find the De Morgan slip from S1.L1.

mirror.text:
; CL-1.1 (LAB-1.3): the corrected guard never overdraws the sender, over Int.
; Premises, the guard, and the violation. unsat means no such transfer exists.
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(declare-const amount Int)
(assert (>= a 0))
(assert (>= b 0))
(assert (> amount 0))
(assert (<= amount a))
(assert (< (- a amount) 0))
(check-sat)

; CL-1.2 (LAB-1.5): a transfer conserves the total, over Int.
; The violation asks for a transfer after which the total differs.
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-const a Int)
(declare-const b Int)
(declare-const amount Int)
(assert (>= a 0))
(assert (>= b 0))
(assert (> amount 0))
(assert (<= amount a))
(assert (not (= (+ (- a amount) (+ b amount)) (+ a b))))
(check-sat)

schema: "statespace/claim@1"
id: "guard-never-overdraws"
template: "CL-1.1"
proposition: "the guarded transfer never overdraws the sender, over Int"
statement:
  path: "claims/guard.smt2"
assumptions:
  - text: "balances are unbounded integers"
    seam: "SEAM-1"
  - text: "the solver is sound"
    seam: "SEAM-7"
model: "two accounts over Int; a transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient"
method:
  receipt: "receipts/LAB-1.3/lab-1.3-20261105.json"
correspondence:
  text: "the SMT-LIB encoding is not checked against code"
if_weakened:
  text: "drop the guard amount <= a: a sender holding 0 can send 1 and ends below zero"
requirement:
  text: "a transfer never leaves the sender owing money"
rests_on: []
supersedes: null

schema: "statespace/claim@1"
id: "transfer-conserves-total"
template: "CL-1.2"
proposition: "a transfer conserves the total, over Int"
statement:
  path: "claims/conservation.smt2"
assumptions:
  - text: "balances are unbounded integers"
    seam: "SEAM-1"
model: "two accounts over Int; the total is their sum"
method:
  receipt: "receipts/LAB-1.5/lab-1.5-20261108.json"
correspondence:
  text: "the SMT-LIB encoding is not checked against code"
if_weakened:
  text: "credit the recipient one less than the amount debited: the total drops by one"
requirement:
  text: "money is neither created nor destroyed by a transfer"
rests_on: []
supersedes: null
